- Use case: real-time semantic search across customer support logs (initial pilot 3 months)
- Expected start: Nov 2026
- Anticipated monthly spend: ~$30k (pilot), scale to $120k+/mo if successful

Can you kick off ACE from your side and loop in the right PDM/PSM? I’ve attached the minimal ACE intake form from AWS. AWS would like a short co-sell plan and confirmation of any compliance requirements before we finalize enrollment.

Proposed next steps:
1) Redwood completes ACE intake form (attached)
2) PDM/PSM intro + one internal technical kickoff (30–45 min)
3) Shared co-sell plan (1 pager) to include target outcomes and timeline

If you want, we can target next week for the intro call — open slots Tue/Wed afternoon PT.

Thanks — Samir

Proposed kickoff (30–45 min):
- Introductions (5 min)
- Pilot goals & success metrics (5 min)
- Data shapes and ingestion plan (10 min)
- Environment & access (roles, VPC, secrets) (10 min)

4) Names/emails for the technical participants we should invite
